feature: Application signaling and ROUTE/MMT event paths

ATSC.clause: HELD in SLS; A/337 application event delivery
ATSC.value: HELD identifies broadcaster entry packages. Event delivery uses defined DASH/ISO-BMFF mechanisms and event semantics. Descriptor delivery and event payload/control semantics must be compared separately.

TTA.value: AST is XML-AIT-based with uhdibb namespace/extensions. ROUTE/DASH uses MPD EventStream for static events and emsg for dynamic events. MMT broadcast uses static AEI and dynamic evti in MPU; broadband event paths use the specified MPD/emsg mechanisms.

SBTVD.value: BALD and application-catalog bootstrap are identified; the guide delegates detailed syntax and requirements to ABNT. Full event payload/semantics equivalence is not established.

difference: HELD, AST and BALD are different application descriptors. Shared DASH event carriers do not establish identical event semantics, and the Korean MMT broadcast path is distinct.
impact: Configure descriptor and event generators by delivery path and platform; do not silently apply ROUTE-only event assumptions to MMT.
